author: reek
body: The guard on the three later reduction rules (list-set-at, list-insert-at, and & append over Nil/Cons spines). Each claim below states the wrong value for a shape whose rule does fire, so each must be a hard CDX2001 naming the reduced term. If this file ever compiles, a rule folded to something the runtime never produces, or the unifier admitted Refl against a stuck spine.
